[我方原帖主张] 口袋掉线是人体遮挡 2.4GHz, 不是协议问题

[u/user_46 顶层评论]
Ha, funnily I found that 2.4GHz transmission was more stable when the device was in a bag on my back!

[我方回复 180词]
You've caught something I said badly, and I'd rather fix it than defend it. I wrote it as "your body blocks the signal", and that's too blunt. Up on your back the phone is maybe 30 to 40cm from your ear, and the path can run up past the side of your neck through open air. A trouser pocket is 70 to 80cm away, and the line to the far ear goes straight through your abdomen and your chest. Same body. Very different amount of it sitting in the way. So I shouldn't have written it as "on your body is bad". What I actually meant is how much tissue lands on the straight line, and how low the thing is riding. If that's right it makes a prediction you could kill in about a minute. Move the bag off your back and down to a waist pack, worn behind you. Lower, and the torso goes back into the path. It should get worse. If it doesn't get worse, then I'm missing something, and I'd genuinely want to hear it.

[u/user_46 现在这条 ← 待读]
Nah, I got what you meant, I oversimplified it my comment but basically, it was me agreeing with you. Sometimes, what seems "logical" doesn't work with how the waves travel and this was my example!
